paradigms.name: determiner_noun_agreement

paradigms.name: anaphor_gender_agreement
paradigms.description: A reflexive pronoun must match its antecedent's gender.

paradigms.name: anaphor_number_agreement
paradigms.description: A reflexive pronoun must match its antecedent's number.

paradigms.name: irregular_past_tense

paradigms.name: argument_structure
paradigms.description: Only a transitive verb can take a direct object.

paradigms.name: filler_gap

paradigms.name: npi_licensing

paradigms.name: pronoun_case
paradigms.description: Subjects take nominative case, objects accusative.

paradigms.name: adjective_order
paradigms.description: An attributive adjective comes before its noun.
